sections.text_helper: Section 25.7.26 "EXTI lock register (EXTI_LOCKR)" in chapter 25 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1161.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x070
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can only be written by secure or privileged access. A write access from any
other protection level is discarded, and any read returns zero value. Both illegal write and
read access generate an illegal access event.
Bits 31:1 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 0 GLOCK: Global security privilege EXTI_SECCFGRx/PRIVCFGRx
This bit is written once after reset.
0: Security, privilege open can be modified.
1: Security, privilege locked can no longer be modified.
